settings.title: Choose the piece
settings.body: The hoodie or the crewneck. Same fleece, same heart, same softness - choose whichever feels right for them.

settings.title: Write your note
settings.body: A few words - or just a name. We hand-copy it onto a card that goes in the box. You do not need to have the right words.

settings.title: We send it
settings.body: Straight to their door. No price, no packing slip. Just something soft, arriving when the day was hard.

settings.label: No price, ever
settings.body: No invoice, no packing slip, no price on the label. The recipient will never know what you paid. They will only know you thought of them.

settings.label: A handwritten card
settings.body: Your note, hand-copied onto a card. Even if it is just a name. Even if it is two words. It is the thing that makes a package feel like a person showed up.

settings.label: Ships to them, not you
settings.body: Give their address at checkout. We ship it straight there. You do not need to be an intermediary. You just need to care.

settings.label: You can stay anonymous
settings.body: Sign it with a name, a nickname, or nothing at all. We will copy exactly what you write. The gift will still mean something, whoever it is from.
